tokens.name: outer
tokens.usage: Live's ground around and between devices in the device chain. Max theme id: live_surface_bg area; never painted by the device itself.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Device body, 169 px tall. Section tiles in tiled devices (Auto Filter, Roar). Ground for `text`.

tokens.name: title
tokens.usage: Live's title bar (drawn by Live, not designable) and the ground tiles sit on in tiled devices.

tokens.name: display
tokens.usage: Dark display (LCD) ground, 2 px radius: Live's RetroDisplayBackground. Max: `panel` with themecolor.live_lcd_bg. Every meter, graph and readout lives on it.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: All body text: dial labels and values share this one colour. 5.9:1 on `body` (dark), 6.9:1 (light).

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Dim text and icons inside a display (Saturator's Amt Lo, Auto Pan-Tremolo's phase offset). Equals the body colour in light themes. Dark: #868686, measured on Saturator's Amt Lo in Live 12.4 (was #757575); live_lcd_control_fg_zombie renders the same. Max: live_lcd_control_fg_zombie.

tokens.name: text-axis
tokens.usage: Graph axis labels and readout labels in a display. Live's RetroDisplayScaleText (50 % opacity) over the display: #797979 light, #767981 light cool. Max: live_display_scale_text.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Unlit part of a dial ring (Live's Poti). In light themes it equals the display colour.

tokens.name: pointer
tokens.usage: Dial pointer (Live's PotiNeedle), round at both ends.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Value arc of a dial, graph curves, choosers. Max: live_value_arc (graph curves use it too, not live_display_line_one).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Editable values inside a display, selected display buttons, toggles when on, graph handles. Max: live_display_handle_one.

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Fill of a number box (Live's RangeEditField). Dark value sampled from Live; light values are the theme file's.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Sampled from Live's palette; no confirmed use in the measured devices. Don't use until a reference device shows where.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Graph border and crosshair, the line under a graph (Live's RetroDisplayBackgroundLine). Max: live_spectrum_grid_lines.

tokens.name: grid-decade
tokens.usage: Decade lines and the 0 dB line in a graph. Live's SpectrumGridLines theme colour, translucent: renders #3f3f3f on the dark display, #444444 on the light one. Drawn under the spectrum.

tokens.name: grid-level
tokens.usage: Level lines (±12 dB) in a graph: SpectrumGridLines at half opacity. Renders #2b2b2b dark, #343434 light. Drawn under the spectrum.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: 1 px dividers between control groups; 1 px connectors from a toggle to its dial.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Ground of a number box (Live's ControlTextBack). Text on it is `text`.

tokens.name: box
tokens.usage: Ground of a filled number box and of an unselected button on the body.

tokens.name: button-off
tokens.usage: Toggle beside a dial when off.

tokens.name: button-border
tokens.usage: 1 px border of toggles and number boxes (Live's ControlContrastFrame).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `orange` or `teal` fill inside a display: the colour of the surface behind it.

tokens.name: on-toggle
tokens.usage: Text on a toggle that is on (orange fill).

tokens.name: meter-green
tokens.usage: Level meter, normal range. Raw value from the theme file (StandardVuMeter); in Max use live.meter~, which Live draws.

tokens.name: meter-yellow
tokens.usage: Level meter near the top of its range.

tokens.name: meter-red
tokens.usage: Level meter over 0 dBFS, in the 16 px overload zone.

tokens.name: meter-hold
tokens.usage: 1 px peak-hold tick on a level meter.

tokens.name: meter-gr
tokens.usage: Gain-reduction bar, drawn from the top (OrangeVuMeter).

tokens.name: line-threshold
tokens.usage: Threshold line in a dynamics display (ThresholdLineColor). Teal, never orange.

tokens.name: line-gr
tokens.usage: Gain-reduction line in a dynamics display (GainReductionLineColor). Orange, never teal.

tokens.name: teal-shade
tokens.usage: Saturator's driven-range band behind the curve: the input range the signal covers right now. #195a5f is the design value for static mockups. In Live (dark, measured) it is the theme teal at about 27 % over the display, drawn over the crosshair; see Graph for its motion. Max: live_value_arc at 0.27 alpha.

tokens.name: led-off
tokens.usage: An unlit indicator light: a touch darker than the display, so it all but disappears (Saturator, dark, measured in Live 12.4). Light themes not measured. Max: live_lcd_bg x 0.83.

tokens.name: led-on
tokens.usage: A lit indicator light at full strength: Saturator's soft-clip light, the theme teal at about 65 %. Dark measured in Live 12.4 (#117f8b); light themes not measured. Brightness follows how hard the device works, fading from led-off. Max: live_value_arc x 0.65 in a v8ui.

tokens.name: spectrum
tokens.usage: Spectrum fill behind an EQ curve, drawn over the grid lines. Live's SpectrumDefaultColor: translucent in the light theme, solid #535353 in dark.

statusLegend.measured: Sampled from Live at 100 % zoom: dark from Live 12.4 (Default Dark Neutral Medium, on a P3 display), light and light-cool from the Live 12 manual images. Re-measure before relying on it in another Live version.
statusLegend.theme-file: Raw value from Live's theme file, not checked on screen. Live transforms some accents when it draws them.
statusLegend.estimated: A best guess with no Live reference yet. Measure it (for example with m4l-loop) before treating it as fact.

families.live: "Ableton Sans Small", "Ableton Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Every label and value on a device: dials, readouts, buttons, axis labels. Hierarchy comes from colour, never from size or weight.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Values under dials and in displays. Same face as labels; format as Live does: "50 %", "6.0 dB", "1.20 kHz".

styles.name: title-bar
styles.usage: Device name in Live's title bar. Live draws it; shown only for context in mockups.

spacing.note: Body coordinates in 1x px: (0, 0) is the top-left of the device body under Live's title bar.

tokens.name: body-h
tokens.usage: Device body height, every Live device.

tokens.name: title-h
tokens.usage: Title bar height above the body; drawn by Live, not designable.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Outer margin: displays start at x = 4, y = 4.

tokens.name: max-pad
tokens.usage: Padding Live adds on each side of a Max device: openrect width W shows a body W + 4 wide.

tokens.name: module
tokens.usage: Vertical module: label rows at 8, 64, 120.

tokens.name: row-top
tokens.usage: Label cap of the top control row.

tokens.name: row-mid
tokens.usage: Label cap of the middle control row.

tokens.name: band-label
tokens.usage: Bottom band: label cap.

tokens.name: band-ring
tokens.usage: Bottom band: ring top of a standard dial.

tokens.name: band-value
tokens.usage: Bottom band: value cap.

tokens.name: display-h
tokens.usage: Standard display height at y = 4; ends 7 px above the band labels.

tokens.name: dial-pitch
tokens.usage: Centre-to-centre distance of dials in one group (50–54).

tokens.name: mix-inset
tokens.usage: Last control (Dry/Wet) centred 26–34 px from the right edge, on the band.

tokens.name: tile-gutter
tokens.usage: Gutter and outer margin between tiles in tiled devices.

tokens.name: divider-clear
tokens.usage: Space on each side of a divider.

tokens.name: ring-inset
tokens.usage: A ring sits 13 px in from its display's edge (whole-pixel symmetry, measured in Live).

tokens.name: label-gap
tokens.usage: Label cap to ring top, standard dial.

tokens.name: label-gap-large
tokens.usage: Label cap to ring top, large dial.

tokens.name: notch-lift
tokens.usage: A notched (±) dial in a Max build sits 4 px higher than a plain one.

tokens.name: radius-display
tokens.usage: Displays and tiles.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Boxes, buttons, toggles, meters: square.

tokens.name: dial
tokens.usage: Standard dial ring (26.25 measured). 101 of 108 dials.

tokens.name: dial-large
tokens.usage: Large dial ring. Only the device's defining control; at most one per section.

tokens.name: dial-stroke
tokens.usage: Ring stroke at every dial size.

tokens.name: pointer-w
tokens.usage: Dial pointer width; square outer end, round inner end.

tokens.name: box-h
tokens.usage: Boxes, buttons and toggles, 1 px border included.

tokens.name: box-w
tokens.usage: Number box width, 1 px border included (Auto Pan-Tremolo, 100 %).

tokens.name: meter-w
tokens.usage: Meter box: 1 px border, two 4 px bars and a 1 px gap (stereo), or one 9 px bar.

tokens.name: meter-clip
tokens.usage: Overload zone at the top of a meter, closed by a 1 px tick.

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: Graph handle outer diameter, 1.5 px ring (Auto Filter).

tokens.name: handle-grab
tokens.usage: Graph handle grab radius.

tokens.name: curve
tokens.usage: Graph curve stroke.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, connectors, grid lines, borders.
